title: Appointments to the East Maui water board
summary: On February 25, 2025, a committee voted six to two, with one member excused, to recommend approving Resolution 25-50. The resolution appoints the Hawaiian Homes Commission's representative to the East Maui Regional Community Board. The committee's agenda that day also included a safe parking pilot update.
